I'm a data analyst in training at Brigham Young University (BYU). What I enjoy most is the full path
from raw data to a decision: writing the SQL to pull and join the data, cleaning it, analyzing it in
R or Python, and building a chart, report, or dashboard that makes the answer obvious to someone who
never has to see the code.

I'm looking for data analyst roles where I can turn business questions into clear, useful answers.
Outside of work I follow Formula 1 closely, which is where a lot of my practice datasets come from.
